question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given according to this prohibition?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is named
A slanderer in the Kula Bhairava context is named
inference: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva or a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake as slanderer of Kula Bhairava
plain_english: Not, O goddess, to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
